track: Private source-authentic Particle108 HLSL glslang independent-stage IO mapping candidate variants
hypothesis: HLSL VS/FS semantics link 4/4, but glslang independent HLSL-to-SPIRV compilation yields SPIRV 2/4, so explicit HLSL IO-mapping and auto-location flags may restore structural 4/4 without editing authored shader data.
approach: Run baseline, --hlsl-iomap, --auto-map-locations and combined flags separately on exact original four HLSL pairs in private CI, record only successful stage counts, vulkan1.1 spirv-val and anonymous reflection stage link; no original ShaderLab changes or private program artifacts.
